summary: x_read and linkedin_read accept url as another name for link, as instagram_read already did (design/social-per-network/30-link-owner-registry.md, decision 2): the deployed model called them with url= in 7 of 20 eval turns on 2026-09-25, and each such call cost a retry.
details: A url alone reads exactly as the same link would. A link and a url that spell the same X post or LinkedIn profile differently agree; two different links read nothing and neither is echoed back.
instagram_read's url handling is unchanged in behaviour and wording; all three tools now share one helper for it.
